# Secure code review

Review changes for correctness, security, reliability, and missing tests.

- Lead with concrete findings ordered by severity.
- Cite the affected file and line.
- Explain the behavior or failure mode, not only the rule being violated.
- Keep the summary secondary to findings.
- State clearly when no actionable findings remain.
